newsitem.title: LEBANON: Monitors say Israel, Hizbollah violated ceasefire.
newsitem.headline: Monitors say Israel, Hizbollah violated ceasefire.

text.p: A five-nation monitoring group said that Israeli killing of three Lebanese civilians and guerrilla firing of Katyusha rockets into northern Israel this week violated an April 1996 ceasefire understanding.

The group comprising the United States, France, Israel, Syria and Lebanon issued a statement at midnight on Wednesday after ending a meeting over four complaints of violations filed by both Lebanon and Israel.
The group said the killing of a Lebanese civilian in south Lebanon on July 12 by Israeli tank fire "whether intentional or not, was a violation of the April 26, 1996 understanding".
The understanding, which brought to an end 17 days of an Israeli blitz on Lebanon last year which killed 200 people, banned the targeting of civilians on both sides of the border.
The monitors considered another Israeli mortar attack on July 14 in which two civilians were killed as "a possibly unintentional violation of the April understanding".

The group said that the firing of one Katyusha rocket by Hizbollah into northern Israel on July 15 "whatever the motivation was a violation of the understanding" while the wounding of a Lebanese civilian in guerrilla rocketing of Israel's occupation zone on the same day was an "unintentional violation".

"The Monitoring Group warned of cycles of action and reaction that could erode the Understanding. It called on responsible authorities to exercise caution and restrain in order to defuse tension and protect civilian lives on both sides of the border," the statement said.
